system_notes: Generic scan: one changepoint test over every metric x cohort series, overdispersion-adjusted; breadth, composition and explain-away tests; diagnosis by runtime layer. Decision layer: every regression carries exposed / hit / signed lost-resolution counts with 95% ranges, excess unplanned handoffs over a named baseline, extra time and spend, status at the end of the data, owner, severity and a plain inaction sentence; every figure is defined in `definitions`. Standard: weekly top-decile standards from measured exemplars over the reference period (flagged regression windows excluded); golden set frozen and hashed per tenant before any verification. Hand-authored: the ask-to-metric mapping and the cause-to-change-type policy. Not built: the A09 abandonment-reason judge (no human reason labels exist to calibrate one). No change is deployed by this system; approvals are recorded decisions, not rollouts. definitions.label: Cost coverage
definitions.definition: exposed conversations that carry a cost_usd value / exposed

definitions.label: Days running
definitions.definition: impact window end - onset + 1 (inclusive)

definitions.label: Status at the end of the data
definitions.definition: ongoing: the window reaches the last days of the data; ended: after the window the mechanism metric is back within 25% of the gap to its baseline; persisting: it is not

definitions.label: Recent daily rate
definitions.definition: the same estimate over the last (up to) 7 days of the window, / days

definitions.label: Projected cost of inaction
definitions.definition: recent daily rate x 7 or 30 days; a projection that assumes the recent rate and volume hold; never shown for a problem that has ended

definitions.label: Mechanism metric
definitions.definition: the runtime-layer metric that carries the diagnosed cause, measured in the slice, at baseline and after the window

definitions.label: Standard (best)
definitions.definition: top-decile weekly value over reference weeks: p90 for higher-is-better, p10 for lower-is-better

definitions.label: Standard (typical)
definitions.definition: median weekly value over reference weeks

definitions.label: Gap to the standard
definitions.definition: value in the finding window - standard median

definitions.label: Replay before / after
definitions.definition: values returned by the organisers' replay simulator for the cohort; simulated, not measured from the corpus

definitions.label: Prediction error
definitions.definition: predicted delta - replayed delta, where the prediction is a fraction of the measured gap applied to the replay's own before value
